preconditions: Money is integer CENTS ($15.00 → 1500) via amount_cents, or a decimal STRING via amount ("15.00") — the server parses; never convert units yourself.
The invoice must be issued: 'sent' or 'paid'. A draft is changed with invoice_item_create / invoice_item_update instead.
Debit notes are append-only. A wrong one is answered by a credit_note (invoice_adjustment_record) for the same amount, never removed.

The amount includes its tax. On an invoice with a tax scheme the tax inside it is worked out at the invoice's own rate, not today's (5.45 on a 9% GST invoice holds 0.45), and returned as tax_cents and net_cents; invoice_read tax_summary adds it to the output tax. On an invoice without a scheme tax_cents is 0.

description: [REQUIRES APPROVAL] Issues a numbered debit note that raises what an issued ('sent' or 'paid') invoice is owed: an extra charge, or a price or tax correction. It is numbered from the debit note series and adds amount_cents (or a decimal STRING amount), tax at the invoice's rate inside, in its currency; a 'paid' invoice goes back to 'sent' until the rest is paid. Refuses a draft (change its lines instead), a cancelled invoice, an invoice with no lines, another currency, and a paid invoice with no payment recorded (record it first with invoice_payment_record); every refusal names the call to send. Never deleted: undo one with a credit_note. An agent's call parks for approval. Nothing is sent. NEXT: invoice_read.

amount.description: The amount as a decimal STRING ("25.00") instead of amount_cents — never convert units yourself.

amount_cents.description: The amount the debit note adds, in integer CENTS.

currency.description: Must be the invoice's own currency; omit it to use that currency.

debit_kind.description: What the debit note is for. Omit it for additional_charge.

invoice_id.description: The invoice the debit note raises (invoice_list shows ids); its invoice_number works too.

invoice_number.description: Alias of invoice_id — the invoice's own number.

occurred_at.description: Epoch milliseconds the debit note takes effect. Omit it for now.

reason.description: Why the customer owes more, as the debit note prints it (max 500).

name: invoice_debit_note
